description.value: Your focus is so powerful that it's easy for you to lose track of self care, but fortunately, you've trained to endure periods of stress. You're never @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fatigued] as a result of hunger or starvation as long as you spend time during your daily preparations solving or creating a puzzle or riddle. You only need to sleep for 2 hours a day, and you need only 4 hours of rest between your daily preparations. Choose a Lore skill related to the puzzle or riddle you worked on. Until your next daily preparations, you become trained in that skill, and if you roll a critical failure on a check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] with that Lore skill, you get a failure instead.
